observercam.config.title: Observer Cam Settings
observercam.config.category.title: Observer Cam — %s
observercam.config.live_hint: Changes apply live and save when you leave a page
observercam.config.pov.tooltip: Switch between your normal view and the camera on the Observer's observing face. You keep controlling your player.
observercam.config.recording.tooltip: Record your Observer while you continue playing normally or while viewing its POV. Recording begins only when the red LIVE message and timer appear.
observercam.config.pip.tooltip: Show or hide a small live view from your Observer while you continue using the normal player camera.
observercam.config.replay.save.tooltip: Save the footage currently retained by the optional instant replay buffer. You can also assign its optional shortcut under Observer Cam controls.
observercam.config.reset.tooltip: Restore every Observer Cam setting to its recommended default.
observercam.config.reset.confirm.title: Reset Observer Cam settings?
observercam.config.reset.confirm.message: This restores every Observer Cam setting to its recommended default.
observercam.config.category.camera.toolt: Shot distance, framing height, and Observer POV field of view.
observercam.config.category.movement.too: How quickly and smoothly the cameraman moves and turns.
observercam.config.category.director.too: How the cameraman composes shots, holds stable framing, and follows its target.
observercam.config.category.assistant.to: Optional, client-local personality features for your Observer.
observercam.config.category.recording.to: Visible output folder, storage protection, encoder, and optional game-audio source.
observercam.config.category.video.toolti: Recording format, output resolution, quality, frame rate, and HUD inclusion.
observercam.config.category.picture_in_p: Performance and refresh controls for the live Observer preview.
observercam.config.category.replay.toolt: Optional rolling footage that keeps only the recent time or size you choose.
observercam.config.category.debug.toolti: Optional diagnostics for testing and camera tuning.
observercam.config.setting.outdoor_dista: Preferred filming distance when the target has open space and sky around them.
observercam.config.setting.indoor_distan: Preferred filming distance inside buildings, caves, and other confined spaces.
observercam.config.setting.minimum_dista: Prevents normal shots from placing the Observer uncomfortably close to the player.
observercam.config.setting.maximum_dista: Prevents the Observer from selecting shots that are too far from the player.
observercam.config.setting.camera_height: Preferred elevation above the player's focus point when space permits.
observercam.config.setting.camera_fov.to: Field of view used only while looking through the Observer.
observercam.config.setting.maximum_speed: Fastest normal flight speed. Higher values catch the player sooner but can feel abrupt.
How quickly the cameraman changes velocity while moving toward a new shot.
observercam.config.setting.rotation_spee: Maximum yaw or pitch change per game tick.
observercam.config.setting.position_smoo: How strongly movement responds to the selected shot position.
observercam.config.setting.rotation_smoo: How strongly the Observer turns toward the player's framing point.
observercam.config.setting.catch_up_dist: Distance at which the director prioritizes catching up over holding the current shot.
observercam.config.setting.emergency_dis: Distance at which a safe emergency reposition is allowed after teleports or severe separation.
observercam.config.setting.background_im: How strongly the director favors camera angles with environmental depth behind the player.
observercam.config.setting.player_visibi: How heavily clear head-to-legs visibility influences candidate scoring.
observercam.config.setting.shot_stabilit: Higher values make the director more reluctant to abandon a usable current angle.
observercam.config.setting.reframe_thres: Minimum current-shot quality before the director considers the composition stable.
observercam.config.setting.player_screen: Approximate desired height of the player in the Observer POV frame.
observercam.config.setting.prediction_ti: How far ahead the director conservatively predicts a moving player's position.
observercam.config.setting.cameraman_ena: While connected to a world, On creates or resumes your Observer cameraman and Off dismisses it.
observercam.config.setting.follow_automa: When enabled, your Observer directs and follows its assigned target; turn it off to leave the camera parked.
observercam.config.setting.allow_front_s: Allows angles in front of the player's movement direction. Disable for mostly rear and side shots.
observercam.config.setting.assistant_ena: Off by default. When enabled, your own Observer can occasionally speak in your local chat; nothing is broadcast to the server.
observercam.config.setting.assistant_fac: Lets the talkative Observer share occasional Minecraft and filming facts while its cameraman is present.
observercam.config.setting.assistant_spe: Shows a short, wall-occluded caption above your own Observer for eight seconds. It is hidden in menus, full Observer POV, auxiliary captures, and with the HUD.
observercam.config.setting.assistant_sho: Keeps the full fact in your local chat history. Nothing is sent to the server or other players.
observercam.config.setting.assistant_rea: Uses Minecraft's bundled narrator voice without an extra installation. Speech is local, non-spatial, and follows the Voice volume slider.
observercam.config.setting.assistant_pre: Immediately tests the configured caption, chat, and voice outputs without changing the normal fact countdown. Enable the assistant and its Observer first.
observercam.config.setting.assistant_fac: How many active gameplay minutes the Observer waits between facts, from one to five minutes.
observercam.config.setting.recording_sto: Maximum combined space for Observer Cam-owned recordings and replay data. Unrelated files in a shared folder never count toward this cap.
observercam.config.setting.recording_out: Choose the folder where Observer Cam will save video files. Click to browse.
observercam.config.setting.open_recordin: Create the selected video folder if needed, then open it in your file manager.
observercam.config.setting.recording_vid: MP4 is the compatibility default, MKV is more resilient to interruption, and WebM uses the open VP9 codec.
observercam.config.setting.recording_fra: Target video and background Observer render rate, up to 120 FPS. Higher values are intended for powerful systems and greatly increase rendering and readback work.
observercam.config.setting.recording_inc: Applies while viewing Observer POV. Background Observer recordings stay clean so your normal player HUD is never mixed into them.
observercam.config.setting.picture_in_pi: A bounded live Observer preview, similar to an upgraded paper doll. It hides automatically while full Observer POV is active or the HUD is hidden. Switching it on briefly pulses the Observer's vanilla rear red output dot.
Changes the on-screen preview size without increasing its render cost. Big matches Observer Cam's original PiP size.
Compact removes the status text and header, leaving only a one-pixel outline. Labeled restores the red-dot OBSERVER LIVE header.
observercam.config.pip_frame_style.label: Labeled
observercam.config.setting.picture_in_pi: Controls the actual secondary world-render size. Balanced is recommended; Ultra is optional and much more demanding.
How often the Observer preview renders, up to 60 FPS. 5 FPS is the recommended low-impact default.
Adjusts the transparency of the entire live preview, including its image and compact frame. 100% is fully opaque.
observercam.config.setting.recording_ffm: Select ffmpeg.exe if FFmpeg is not available through your system PATH. Reset Defaults returns to automatic PATH detection.
observercam.config.setting.recording_aud: Off by default. Turn this on after choosing a game-audio loopback device; Observer Cam never selects a microphone automatically.
Choose a Windows game-audio loopback source such as Stereo Mix. Microphones are deliberately excluded from this list.
observercam.config.audio.instructions: Choose the Windows game-audio loopback source Observer Cam should record. Microphones are deliberately excluded.
observercam.config.audio.none_found: No game-audio loopback source is enabled in Windows. Recording will continue as video only.
observercam.config.audio.scan_failed: Observer Cam could not scan audio devices. Check the selected FFmpeg executable and try again.
observercam.config.audio.unsupported: Automatic audio-device selection is currently available on Windows.
observercam.config.setting.recording_res: Controls both the real background Observer render size and final output. 720p reduces gameplay impact; 1440p and 4K are optional high-end modes.
observercam.config.setting.recording_qua: High keeps more detail, Balanced is recommended, and Smaller Files uses stronger compression.
observercam.config.setting.instant_repla: Off by default. When On, your Observer buffers recent footage while you play normally or view its POV.
observercam.config.setting.save_instant_: Finalize the retained rolling footage as a normal video, then resume buffering automatically.
observercam.config.setting.instant_repla: Choose whether the rolling replay buffer evicts old footage by elapsed time or disk size.
How many recent minutes the instant replay buffer retains before evicting its oldest complete segments.
Maximum temporary replay footage to retain. It can never exceed the overall recording storage cap.
observercam.config.setting.debug_hud.too: Shows the director state, target, score, visibility, distance, and movement data while in Observer POV.
observercam.config.setting.show_candidat: Marks evaluated camera positions with lightweight colored particles.
observercam.config.setting.show_rays.too: Draws the selected camera-to-target line used during framing checks.
observercam.config.setting.show_selected: Highlights the director's chosen camera destination.
observercam.config.setting.show_collisio: Marks candidate positions rejected because the Observer would intersect blocks.

observercam.assistant.name: Observer
observercam.assistant.fact.octopus.bubbl: Three hearts. One pauses while swimming.
observercam.assistant.fact.octopus.messa: Octopuses have three hearts. Their main systemic heart pauses during jet swimming while the two gill hearts continue pumping.
observercam.assistant.fact.cloud.message: A roughly one-kilometer-wide cumulus cloud can weigh about 1.1 million pounds.
observercam.assistant.fact.banana.messag: Botanically, bananas are berries, while strawberries are aggregate accessory fruits.
observercam.assistant.fact.honey.bubble: Sealed honey can last for millennia.
observercam.assistant.fact.honey.message: Properly sealed honey's low water content can keep it edible for thousands of years.
observercam.assistant.fact.butterfly.mes: Butterflies taste with sensory receptors on their feet.
observercam.assistant.fact.flamingo.bubb: A flamingo group is a flamboyance.
observercam.assistant.fact.flamingo.mess: One collective noun for a group of flamingos is a flamboyance.
observercam.assistant.fact.dolphin.messa: Bottlenose dolphins develop individual signature whistles that can function like vocal labels.
observercam.assistant.fact.horse.message: A horse's strong lower esophageal sphincter and stomach anatomy make vomiting practically impossible.
observercam.assistant.fact.axolotl.messa: Axolotls can regenerate damaged portions of their brain.
observercam.assistant.fact.jellyfish.mes: Jellyfish ancestors lived hundreds of millions of years before the first dinosaurs.
observercam.assistant.fact.wood_frog.bub: Wood frogs can freeze and survive.
observercam.assistant.fact.wood_frog.mes: Wood frogs can freeze through winter with no heartbeat or breathing, then thaw and resume activity.
observercam.assistant.fact.penguin.messa: Some penguins use pebbles during courtship and to build their nests.
observercam.assistant.fact.snail.bubble: Snails carry thousands of tiny teeth.
observercam.assistant.fact.snail.message: Snails use a radula: a flexible band bearing thousands of microscopic tooth-like spikes.
observercam.assistant.fact.seahorse.mess: Male seahorses carry embryos in a brood pouch and give birth to live young.
observercam.assistant.fact.woodpecker.bu: A woodpecker's hyoid loops its skull.
observercam.assistant.fact.woodpecker.me: A woodpecker's hyoid apparatus loops around its skull to support its long tongue.
observercam.assistant.fact.polar_bear.me: Polar bears have black skin beneath pigment-free fur that appears white.
observercam.assistant.fact.blue_whale.bu: Blue whale hearts can top 180 kg.
observercam.assistant.fact.blue_whale.me: A blue whale's heart can weigh well over 180 kilograms.
observercam.assistant.fact.fungus_ants.m: Fungus-growing ants cultivate fungal crops for food.
observercam.assistant.fact.honeybee.mess: Honeybees can learn to distinguish images of human faces.
observercam.assistant.fact.cockroach.bub: A headless roach survives for days.
observercam.assistant.fact.cockroach.mes: A headless cockroach can survive for days, but eventually dies from dehydration.
observercam.assistant.fact.elephant.bubb: Elephants can recognize a mirror self.
observercam.assistant.fact.elephant.mess: Asian elephants have shown mirror self-recognition.
observercam.assistant.fact.ballooning_sp: Some spiders travel through the air by ballooning on strands of silk.
observercam.assistant.fact.cattle.messag: Cattle form preferred social partnerships, and familiar companions can reduce stress.
observercam.assistant.fact.giraffe.messa: Giraffes have seven neck vertebrae, the same number as humans, only much longer.
observercam.assistant.fact.shrimp.bubble: A shrimp's heart sits near its head.
observercam.assistant.fact.shrimp.messag: A shrimp's heart sits in its cephalothorax, the fused head-and-thorax region.
observercam.assistant.fact.owl.message: Owls' eyes are fixed in their sockets, so they turn their heads to change their gaze.
observercam.assistant.fact.sea_star.bubb: Sea stars have no central brain.
observercam.assistant.fact.sea_star.mess: Sea stars have no centralized brain; they use a nerve ring and radial nerves.
observercam.assistant.fact.crow.bubble: A crow group can be a murder.
observercam.assistant.fact.crow.message: One traditional collective noun for a group of crows is a murder.
observercam.assistant.fact.horned_lizard: Horned lizards can squirt eye blood.
Some horned lizards can squirt blood from vessels around their eyes to deter predators.
observercam.assistant.fact.platypus_uv.m: Platypus fur fluoresces blue-green under ultraviolet light.
observercam.assistant.fact.platypus_stom: Platypuses lack a functional acid-secreting stomach.
Some snakes glide through the air.
Flying snakes flatten and undulate their bodies to glide between trees.
observercam.assistant.fact.mantis_shrimp: Mantis shrimp punch at extreme speed.
Some mantis shrimp accelerate their striking appendages fast enough to produce powerful underwater impacts.
observercam.assistant.fact.lobster.messa: Lobsters use chemosensory hairs on their legs and feet to detect food.
observercam.assistant.fact.crocodile.mes: A membrane holds a crocodile's tongue in place, so it cannot stick it out.
observercam.assistant.fact.frigatebird.m: Great frigatebirds can take brief, mostly one-hemisphere naps while flying.
observercam.assistant.fact.ant_lungs.mes: Ants have no lungs; air enters through spiracles and moves through tracheal tubes.
observercam.assistant.fact.lightning.bub: Lightning-heated air tops the Sun's surface.
observercam.assistant.fact.lightning.mes: Lightning can heat nearby air to about 50,000 degrees Fahrenheit, hotter than the Sun's visible surface.
observercam.assistant.narrator_unavailab: The narrator is unavailable, so facts will remain visual.
observercam.assistant.preview.disabled: Enable Talkative assistant and Say cool facts first.
observercam.assistant.preview.no_observe: Enable your Observer cameraman before previewing a fact.
observercam.message.cameraman.spawn_fail: Observer cameraman could not be created. Try again after the area finishes loading.
observercam.message.pov.unavailable: No Observer cameraman is available. Enable it in Mod Menu first.
observercam.message.pov.lost: Observer POV ended because the cameraman is no longer available.
observercam.message.command.no_nearby: You do not have an Observer cameraman.
